title: RobotState
description: A hub-local projection of a paired robot's current state, keyed externally by device_id and never synced or given its own record identity (home docs/dev.md, ‘Robot device state’; bot docs/dev.md, ‘Robot device state’ pointer). It deliberately has no id, timestamps, or hlc. Battery, daemon and app version fields may be omitted by producers that do not report them yet; explicit null means the body cannot tell or has no version to report. Reachy Mini always sends null for on_battery per section 7 of the design record.

activity.description: The robot's current interaction phase, so the hub can show an accurate Devices-page card, including the distinct startup state. reconnecting means the robot lost the hub link and is trying to restore it. sleeping means the robot is deliberately idle, not unreachable. A consumer that meets an activity value it does not know treats it as unknown, not as an error.

muted.description: Whether the robot's microphone is muted, so the card can show when it cannot hear the household.

tracking.description: Whether the robot's tracking behavior is active, so the card can expose that live device state.

clock_synced.description: Whether the robot's clock was last corrected against the hub's. Omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

on_battery.description: Whether the robot is running on battery power. Null means its body cannot tell; Reachy Mini always sends null per section 7 of the design record. Omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

battery_level.description: The available battery fraction from 0 to 1, allowing the Devices-page card to show charge when the robot reports it. Null means no level is currently known; omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

daemon_version.description: The robot daemon version, when available, so the hub can display which software is running. Null means no version is currently known; omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

motion.description: Whether the body is resting on a surface or being held, so the hub can show when someone is carrying the robot. Null means the body cannot tell; omission means the producer does not yet report this field. A consumer that meets a value it does not know treats it as unknown, not as an error.

put_down_count.description: How many times the robot has been put down since it started, a non-negative running count the hub can compare between frames. Omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

app_version.description: The MaiPai app version the robot runs (the maipai-bot release), so the hub can compare the robot to a published Bot release; daemon_version is the vendor SDK's version, not this one. Null means no version is currently known; omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

motors_latched.description: Names of the motors the robot's motor gate has latched off after a failed recovery, so the hub can show which parts are down. An empty list means none are latched. Omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

motors_stuck.description: Whether the robot's stuck-servo recovery ladder is currently running (any stage other than healthy), so the card can say the body is working on a motor problem. Omission means the producer does not yet report this field.

motors_reboot_offer.description: Names of the latched motors for which the robot asks the hub to offer a reboot to an adult (a latched servo error that cycling the motor mode did not clear). Always a subset of motors_latched. An empty list means no offer is pending; omission means the producer does not yet report this field. The hub shows one card offer and, on an adult's yes, sends a motor_reboot command naming these motors; the robot never reboots a motor on its own while a person may be touching the head.

level.description: The thermal governor's current step: nominal, vision slowed, gestures suspended, then idle and still. A consumer that meets a level it does not know treats it as unknown, not as an error.

temp_c.description: The last measured body temperature in degrees Celsius. Null means no reading is available.

vision_hz.description: The camera processing rate the governor currently allows, in frames per second.

fault.description: Whether the temperature sensor could not be read, so the level is a best guess.

thermal.description: The robot's thermal governor state, so the hub can say why the robot has slowed down. Omission means the producer does not report thermal state (no monitor wired).

watch_level.description: The effective local camera watch level the robot reports to the hub, using the strictest applicable person and device setting.

presence.description: Optional shared activity state for the web character and robot body. It contains no person identity, turn outcome, or reason.
